Measured directly from data/individual-routes/gas-pipelines/P2746.geojson (haversine over each vertex pair): the file holds ONE line, 384.0 km, running 77.043E/12.784N (Bengaluru direction) down to 76.004E/10.839N (Koottanad area) — geographically the Koottanad–Bengaluru branch, not the Koottanad–Mangaluru one. Two independent sources place the true Koottanad–Bengaluru extent well above 384 km: nsenergybusiness.com reports 'the 625km pipeline segment between Koottanad and Bangalore' (still under construction as of that article), and psuwatch.com's April-2026 update gives the KKBMPL Phase-II authorised length as 901 km with 'Construction... in progress in approximately 322 km in Tamil Nadu' still outstanding on that branch as of the article date — so P2746's drawn 384 km is a genuine partial trace of ONLY the Bengaluru branch, undershooting its own eventual extent, and does not include the Koottanad–Mangaluru branch (~440-450 km, independently reported as already commissioned by 2019/2026) at all — that geometry sits instead under P0934, which is labelled Phase I / Kochi-only. That misassignment is why the two rows' length ratios point in opposite directions (P0934 overshoots by carrying extra geometry; P2746 undershoots by missing a whole branch) even though the two rows' LengthKnownKm VALUES already sum correctly to the register's 1,104 km authorisation (44 + 1,060 = 1,104 — noted independently by the register-crosswalk leg).
